card.name: Words just before the word therapy
card.fires_on: The word "alternative" (or "medical", or "of") right before the word therapy or treatment, usually in warnings like "discontinue and institute alternative therapy".

modes.label: Alternative before therapy
modes.description: The word "alternative" after "institute" or "discontinue ... and" in warnings about stopping a drug.
modes.example: If paradoxical bronchospasm occurs, discontinue Fluticasone Furoate/Vilanterol ELLIPTA and institute<< alternative>> therapy.

modes.label: Of before therapy or treatment
modes.description: The word "of" after "initiation" or "failure", where therapy or treatment comes next.
modes.example: at least upon initiation<< of>> therapy, in systemic infections caused by this

modes.label: Medical before management
modes.description: The word "medical" in "optimal medical management", where a therapy-type noun follows.
modes.example: cannot be achieved with optimal<< medical>> management, withhold ALUNBRIG until

card.plain: It fires on the word just before "therapy" is expected, as in "institute alternative therapy".
